overview: This Senate resolution updates which senators from the majority party sit on several Senate committees for the current Congress. It adds newly arrived Senators Husted and Moody to committees including Environment and Public Works; Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions; Homeland Security; the Judiciary; Aging; Small Business; and the Joint Economic Committee, and adjusts the Intelligence Committee roster. Committees are where most bills are first reviewed and changed, so these assignments shape who handles which issues. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 24, 2025.
for: Supporters say the update is needed to give new senators committee seats so they can take part fully in the Senate's work.
against: Critics say the resolution is routine housekeeping that does not change any law or policy.
